title: Enable MCE (Intel)
name: mce-intel
modal: WARNING: Your PC will restart IMMEDIATELY into the BIOS/UEFI setup. Save all work first. MCE raises CPU clocks, heat and power draw. Make sure your cooling can handle it.
description: Reboots to BIOS to enable Multi-Core Enhancement on Intel for full all-core turbo clocks
deepDescription:
Multi-Core Enhancement (ASUS) or removing turbo power limits (other boards) keeps Intel CPUs at max all-core turbo for more FPS. Requires an Intel CPU. This tweak reboots you into BIOS. Enable there:

- Multi-Core Enhancement → Enabled (Remove All Limits)

Watch CPU temperatures afterwards. Do not change anything else.
warning: PC restarts immediately. Save your work first.
